extracted.name: Grandma’s Rice Pudding
extracted.description: Grandma’s rice pudding recipe is a simple hot rice pudding served with cinnamon, It’s made with long-grain rice, 2-percent milk, and evaporated milk.
instruction_lines: Bring water and rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and water has been absorbed, about 20 minutes.
Add milk, evaporated milk, sugar, and butter; stir well and cook until creamy, about 20 minutes more. Sprinkle with cinnamon, then serve.
